query:
SELECT DISTINCT s.id AS "id!: i64", s.name AS "name!: String", c.number AS "run!: i64" FROM check_results s
                    JOIN check_runs c ON c.id = s.run_id
                    JOIN check_runs lr ON lr.tree_hash = c.tree_hash AND lr.number > c.number
                    JOIN check_results l ON l.run_id = lr.id AND l.kind = 'check'
                         AND l.name = s.name AND l.outcome = 'passed'
                    WHERE s.kind = 'check' AND s.outcome IN ('failed', 'timed_out') AND c.created_at >= ?1 ORDER BY s.name, c.number, s.id
